title: aimbot script no key
features:
🎯 Features
Auto‑Aim – Locks onto the nearest enemy player instantly.

Smooth Aiming – Adjustable smoothness (0–1) for natural, human‑like movement.

FOV Slider – Set your field of view (default 120°). Only targets inside this cone are tracked.

Toggle Key – Press Q to enable/disable the aimbot on the fly.

Team Check – Option to ignore teammates (disabled by default, but you can enable it).

Visibility Check – Only aims if the target is visible (no wall‑bangs).

Target Part – Choose which body part to aim for (Head, HumanoidRootPart, etc.).

Lightweight – Runs smoothly with minimal performance impact.
